name: event-count-incremental
description: updateEventRanges adds to the job's nEvents the events of the ranges the call reports finished, in place of a recount of the job's finished ranges: the recount walks every range of a fine-grained job on every call, and on PostgreSQL it failed on a :PandaID bind. No query is added.

pandaserver/taskbuffer/db_proxy_mods/tas:
# sql to set nEvents
            sqlS = "UPDATE ATLAS_PANDA.jobsActive4 "
            sqlS += f"SET nEvents=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM {panda_config.schemaJEDI}.JEDI_Events "
            sqlS += "WHERE jediTaskID=:jediTaskID AND PandaID=:PandaID AND status IN (:esFinished,:esDone,:esMerged))*:nEvents "
            sqlS += "WHERE PandaID=:pandaID "
            if version == 2:
                sqlS += "OR jobsetID=:pandaID "
            # sql to add to nEvents the events of the ranges this call reports finished. A
            # recount of the job's finished ranges walks every range of a fine-grained job
            # on every call; the pilot's heartbeat and final update set the count outright.
            sqlS = "UPDATE ATLAS_PANDA.jobsActive4 "
            sqlS += "SET nEvents=COALESCE(nEvents,0)+:nEvents "
            sqlS += "WHERE PandaID=:pandaID "
            if version == 2:
                sqlS += "OR jobsetID=:pandaID "
